title: Noah
summary: Tenth from Adam; built the Ark and with his family survived the Flood.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 4: Ussher, Annals: 1056 AM, 2948 BC (no higher-tier year available).

birth.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), "Chronological Compendium", p. 1
birth.note: Jones prints only the AM figure here; no BC year is printed for this birth, so year_bc_ad is left null (not inferred).
